text: There are 4 boxes on the counters in this kitchen. An egg and a lime are inside them. Put both in the bowl, then press Submit. You act through helper actions; the helpers move objects exactly. Instead of pressing Submit, give your answer with SUBMIT.
intro: On the work counter you see one box, box 1. Every box is the same wooden case, about 26 cm wide and 22 cm tall. Box 1: you see its top, front and left side; a knobbed panel is on its top. Part of a box shows at the left edge of the left camera's view. Part of a box shows at the right edge of the right camera's view. The far sides of the boxes and parts of the kitchen are out of view. The bowl stands at the front of the work counter.
help:
LOOK AROUND THE KITCHEN - walk round the counters and the kitchen: find the boxes out of view and see every side of every box
<WAY> BOX n <FACE> - work the knobbed panel on one face of box n in one way; if the box opens, reach inside. FACE is FRONT (the side toward you), BACK, LEFT, RIGHT or TOP. Example: PULL BOX 2 FRONT
  ways for a panel on a side face:
  PULL - pull the knob straight out
  SWING - pull the knob out along an arc, about the panel's left or right edge
  PRESS THEN PULL - press the panel in firmly, then pull the knob straight out
  PRESS THEN SWING - press the panel in firmly, then pull the knob out along an arc
  TURN THEN PULL - turn the knob a quarter turn, then pull it straight out
  PUSH SIDEWAYS - push the panel sideways along the face
  PUSH UP - push the panel up the face
  ways for a panel on the top:
  LIFT - lift the panel straight up by its knob
  SLIDE - push the panel along the top, away from you
  TURN THEN LIFT - turn the knob a quarter turn, then lift the panel straight up
  TIP UP - lift the near edge of the panel
SUBMIT a b - take what is inside the named boxes (each one you opened) and put it in the bowl (your answer)
